main.description: A reusable, portable description of WHO a piece of gated content is for and HOW an entitled viewer obtains a decryption key. Deliberately free of foryour.fans database IDs and of any subscriber/billing data — a competing fan-service app must be able to implement its own payment relationship and its own key issuance from this record alone. See docs/creator-owned-pds.md.

audience.description: public: no gate. subscribers: any active paid subscription to this creator. tier: an active subscription at `minimumTier` or higher.

minimumTier.description: Required when audience is `tier`. A stable AT reference to a fans.foryour.tier record — never a local database id.

keyGrant.description: Present when the gated payload is encrypted. Describes the protocol a subscriber's client uses to request a content key.

bundle.description: Future-proofing hook for promotions/bundles: additional tier refs that also satisfy this policy. Empty/absent today.

uri.description: AT URI of the fans.foryour.tier record.

rkey.description: The tier record's rkey, denormalized so a resolver need not parse the URI.

keyGrantMethod.description: Contains NO key material and NO subscriber identities.

protocol.description: Key-grant protocol identifier. `foryour.fans/keygrant-v1`: POST the target content AT URI with a viewer DID auth token to `endpoint`; receive an entitlement-checked, per-content wrapped key.

endpoint.description: Key-grant HTTP endpoint. Absent means use the creator's fans.foryour.serviceConfig#keyGrantEndpoint.

fans.foryour.embed.images.description: A set of images embedded in a fans.foryour.post record.

image.description: Uploaded to the creator's own PDS — public post media only. Subscriber-only media never goes through this lexicon; see PHASE 7/8 in prompts/full.md.

main.description: A like on a fans.foryour.post, held in the LIKER's own repo (never the creator's). Public: like records ride the open AT network exactly as app.bsky.feed.like does, and — for a like on a PUBLIC post — a foryour.fans-compatible app pairs it with an app.bsky.feed.post like so Bluesky renders the count too. Unlike = delete this record. Structurally identical to app.bsky.feed.like's `subject`; the shape is inlined as `#subject` rather than referencing com.atproto.repo.strongRef, matching fans.foryour.post's `#recordRef`/`#mediaRef` convention (this package does not codegen com.atproto.* refs).

subject.description: Strong reference (AT URI + CID) to the fans.foryour.post being liked. Match on `uri` only — a post edit re-mints the CID under the same rkey, so an older like's `cid` is a stale integrity anchor, not a join key.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the like was created.

subject.description: A com.atproto.repo.strongRef-shaped pointer: AT URI plus the CID of the referenced record at like time.

main.description: A single media asset stored on the creator's OWN PDS as a blob. For PUBLIC posts the blob is cleartext bytes; for gated (subscriber/tier) posts the blob is ciphertext and `encryption` describes how an entitled subscriber decrypts it. foryour.fans-owned object storage is NEVER the durable home for this — see docs/creator-owned-pds.md and prompts/creator-owned-pds.md.

blob.description: The media bytes on the creator's PDS. Cleartext for public media; AES-256-GCM ciphertext when `encryption` is present.

mimeType.description: The plaintext media MIME type (e.g. image/jpeg). May differ from the blob's own mimeType when the blob holds ciphertext.

duration.description: Duration in whole seconds, for audio/video.

labels.description: Self-label content warnings, using the core protocol's self-label mechanism.

encryption.description: Present ONLY for gated media. Absence means the blob is public cleartext.

encryptionMetadata.description: How to decrypt a gated media blob. Contains NO key material — only a reference a compatible service resolves to a per-media content key via its own entitlement/key-grant flow.

keyRef.description: Opaque identifier a key-grant endpoint maps to the per-media content key. Conventionally the media record's own AT URI. Never the key itself.

tag.description: Base64-encoded AEAD authentication tag, when not appended to the ciphertext.

main.description: A creator post on the creator's own PDS. A post with no `visibility` (or `visibility: public`) is a normal public record on the open AT network, and — when authored through a foryour.fans-compatible app — is paired with an `app.bsky.feed.post` (see `bskyUri`). A post with `visibility` `subscribers` or `tier` is GATED: its body is carried in `encryptedBody` (never `text`), any media is encrypted, and it is NEVER also written as an app.bsky.feed.post. See docs/creator-owned-pds.md.

text.description: Cleartext body for a PUBLIC post. MUST be an empty string for a gated post (the real body is in `encryptedBody`). May also be empty for a public post that is only media.

visibility.description: Absent is treated as `public` for backward compatibility with pre-rearchitecture records.

embed.description: Inline public post media, Bluesky-compatible. Public posts only.

media.description: References to fans.foryour.media records on the same PDS. Used for gated media and for media shared with the paired app.bsky.feed.post.

accessPolicy.description: Reference to the fans.foryour.accessPolicy record governing this post. Required for gated posts; omitted for public posts.

encryptedBody.description: The AES-256-GCM-encrypted post body, present ONLY for gated posts. Contains no key material.

labels.description: Self-label content warnings for this post, using the core protocol's self-label mechanism.

langs.description: BCP-47 language codes, mirrored from the paired app.bsky.feed.post so the custom record round-trips everything the Bluesky copy carries. See prompts/bluesky-public-posts.md.

tags.description: Additional hashtags (without a leading '#'), mirrored from the paired app.bsky.feed.post.

bskyUri.description: AT URI of the paired app.bsky.feed.post, for public posts dual-published through a compatible app. Field semantics owned by prompts/bluesky-public-posts.md / docs/bluesky-public-posts.md. Absent on gated posts (never dual-published) and on public posts authored where Bluesky publishing was unavailable.

bskyCid.description: CID of the paired app.bsky.feed.post at publish time.

canonicalUri.description: Which of the paired records is canonical for display/dedupe. This app always sets it to this fans.foryour.post record's own URI. See docs/bluesky-public-posts.md §4.

sourceApp.description: Identifier of the fan-service app that authored this record, e.g. `foryour.fans`.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this post was originally created.

updatedAt.description: Client-declared timestamp of the most recent edit, when edited.

uri.description: AT URI of a fans.foryour.media record.

encryptedBody.description: Contains NO key material — only a reference the key-grant endpoint maps to a per-post content key.

keyRef.description: Opaque per-post content-key identifier. Conventionally this post record's own AT URI.

ciphertext.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM ciphertext of the UTF-8 post body (auth tag appended).

main.description: A public creator profile on this platform. Contains only information the creator has chosen to publish to the open AT network — never billing, payout, or subscriber data. See docs/atproto-vs-database.md.

avatar.description: Profile picture. Uploaded to the creator's own PDS, not application storage — see docs/architecture.md.

banner.description: Larger horizontal banner image for the profile page.

main.description: Creator-owned pointer record: which compatible fan-service app(s) the creator uses and where their key-grant / entitlement endpoints live. Lets a creator move between compatible services WITHOUT rewriting any content record. MUST NOT contain subscriber lists, legal names, payment customer IDs, payout info, or any private billing data — see docs/atproto-vs-database.md.

primaryAppEndpoint.description: Base URL of the fan-service app the creator currently publishes through.

compatibleAppEndpoints.description: Other fan-service apps the creator authorizes to render/serve this creator's records.

keyGrantEndpoint.description: Default HTTP endpoint that issues entitlement-checked decryption keys for this creator's gated content.

entitlementIssuer.description: DID or HTTPS origin of the party that vouches for a viewer's paid entitlement to the key-grant endpoint. Usually the primary app.

main.description: Public metadata for one of a creator's paid subscription tiers — name/price/description only, so prospective subscribers can see what's on offer. The authoritative billing record (Prisma SubscriptionTier, see prompts/full.md Phase 5) is never mirrored here beyond these safe fields. MUST NOT ever contain: customer payment IDs, billing history, subscriber lists, legal names, tax information, or payout information.

monthlyPrice.description: Integer minor units (e.g. cents), matching the private SubscriptionTier.priceCents convention — never a decimal major-unit amount.
